The amended bill is expected to be brought before the House plenum for a vote on Thursday. According to Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides, following a recent closed session of the House [...]

The lawyers started flagging this on Monday, and the amended bill is lined up for a vote in the House plenum on Thursday. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides brought it up right after a recent closed session, which just shows how they're coordinating these moves behind closed doors to avoid any pushback. It's all coordinated manipulation to expand control over everyone while pretending it's just routine legislation.
